items.description: Open Weekly Planner, type 'litter' into the search box (top header).
items.expected_result: Within ~300ms an inline dropdown lists up to 8 matching tasks, newest first, each showing instructions snippet + section name + task type name.

items.description: Click a search result in the dropdown.
items.expected_result: Page navigates to the result's own week (?week=<date>&highlight=<task_id>) and that task card scrolls into view and briefly glows amber.

items.description: On Weekly Planner, pick a past date (e.g. a March date) in the date input.
items.expected_result: Page navigates to that date's week (?week=<date>).

items.description: Open Monthly Planner, search 'litter', click a result dated in a different month.
items.expected_result: Page navigates to the result's month (?year=&month=&highlight=<task_id>) and the correct day-cell badge is highlighted.

items.description: Search 'Intern training' (a task with no section and no template), then click it.
items.expected_result: Result shows 'No Section' and 'Custom Task' (no blank/null/None text); lands on correct week with the card highlighted.

items.description: Search 'zzzzz', then clear the box (or enter spaces).
items.expected_result: Empty state (dropdown shows 'No results' or doesn't open); clearing hides the dropdown.

items.description: Note a rolling to-do item's text on the Kanban board, then search that text in planner search.
items.expected_result: The rolling task does not appear (planner search is non-rolling only).
No error; characters treated literally (likely empty list).
302 redirect to login (no JSON/task text leaked to anonymous users).
